title: The first-routine test locks in the 'Skip for now' words that promise a return that never comes
what: The test requires the skip button to say 'Skip for now' and also requires a skip to hide the card for good. It passes on the very fault already found, and will fail whoever fixes the words.
expected: The test checks that the skip words match what happens: either the card comes back later, or the button says it will not.
fix_line: Change the test with the words fix so it asks for words that match the behaviour

title: No test checks the day calendar refuses future days or keeps the picked day
what: The month calendar used for a workout's day and a weigh-in's day has no test of its own. Nothing checks that future days are greyed out, that the next-month arrow stops at this month, or that a picked day stays picked when the calendar opens again.
expected: A test taps a future day and the next-month arrow and sees nothing change, and reopens the calendar to see the picked day still selected.
how_often: every past workout or weigh-in dated by hand
fix_line: Add one small test of the calendar's day rules and one phone step tapping a future day

title: Undo of a deleted set and the 'Remove exercise?' question are never tested
what: In a live workout, putting back a deleted set with Undo has no test at all, so nothing checks it returns to its place or that Undo is withdrawn after a change. The 'Remove exercise?' question and its Cancel are never checked either; only the rest ending is.
expected: A test deletes a set, taps Undo and sees it back in its place; another removes an exercise, sees the question, cancels and keeps the sets, then confirms and sees it left out on Finish.
how_often: whenever a member deletes a set or removes an exercise
fix_line: Add store tests for set undo and a phone step for the remove question

title: The finish sheet's empty-workout and only-unticked cases are never tested
what: No test checks that a workout with no sets shows a greyed 'Tick a set to finish' and cannot be saved empty, that a workout with only unticked sets picks 'Save them' by itself, or that the choice and note boxes reset when the sheet opens again.
expected: Tests open the finish sheet with no sets and with only unticked sets and check the button, the picked choice and the empty boxes on reopening.
fix_line: Add tests for the two edge cases and the reset

title: The how-to sheet is never opened from a live workout, and the member's own photo or video in it is never checked
what: The demo sheet is only opened from the exercise page in tests. Nothing checks it from a live workout (back on the same workout, timer and sets kept), that the exercise page shows the picture without steps twice, that the member's own video or photo shows instead of the library clip, or that a broken own photo falls back.
expected: A phone step opens the sheet from a live workout and closes it, and one checks an exercise with its own photo.
how_often: every look at a how-to during a workout
fix_line: Add a phone step from a live workout and an own-photo check

title: No test checks records stay away for a never-logged exercise or an impossible run time
what: Nothing checks that an exercise never logged shows no records section and no 0 kg record, or that a typo like 2 km in 30 seconds is not shown as the best pace.
expected: Tests feed an empty history and an impossible run set and see no records and no pace record.

title: The chart's free-plan limit and its empty range are never tested
what: No test checks that a free member asking for an older chart range gets the Plus pop-up and stays on 3 months, that a gym member with an active plan is not locked, or that a range with nothing shows a dash and 'Nothing in this range yet' instead of a flat line.
expected: Tests pick an older range as a free member, as a gym member, and on an empty range, and check what shows.
how_often: every free member opening a chart
fix_line: Add chart tests for the limit and the empty range

title: The workout clock's m:ss form and its 0:00 before start are never checked
what: Tests check the paused-time sums and the 'WORKOUT DURATION' title, but nothing checks the clock reads like '12:05', not '12m 05s', or that it stands at 0:00 before the workout starts.
expected: A small test of the clock text, running and not yet started.

title: No test checks the body map or the kg to beat change after a new or deleted workout
what: The body map shading and the Start screen's kilos to beat are only tested on fixed numbers. Nothing checks they update after a new workout, go back after one is deleted, or that the Ready screen draws the figure picked in Profile.
expected: A test adds then deletes a workout and sees the shading and the kilos to beat change and change back.
fix_line: Add one refresh test for each
